name: @keystone-dashboard-layout/angular
description: Angular port of the responsive & dynamic grid / dashboard layout with drag, drop and resizable actions.
author: Geirr Winnem <geirr@winnem.tech>
_comment_scripts: dev/build/lint/lint:fix/test:e2e intentionally still omitted — see docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. `test`/`test:coverage` now run through Jest + jest-preset-angular (mature, widely used for Angular unit/component testing, and — unlike the Vitest paths tried before it — actually available for this package's Angular ^19.0.0 target: Angular's own first-party Vitest builder, @angular/build:unit-test, only exists from v20 (experimental) / v21 (stable), and the third-party @analogjs/vite-plugin-angular route hit a genuinely unresolved upstream ecosystem bug, analogjs/analog#1502 / angular/angular-cli#31732). Karma (angular.json's own project-scoped `test` architect target + karma.conf.js, both still present) is kept for a possible future full-app browser-flow e2e layer, per the same reasoning as before — not used for unit/component tests at all now. turbo skips tasks a package doesn't define, so CI stays green in the meantime.
